environment.installation: task-local venv with read-only inherited dependencies; kernel-validation subset, not full serving installation

wide_gpu_index.note: Supplemental synthetic kernel-only boundary test; no model weights

methodology.baseline: Exact pre-PR QKV view, QK packing/contiguous materialization, one real ApplyRotaryEmb.forward_cuda on packed (2*batch,seq,16,72). Native strided cos/sin are copied by the existing implementation.
methodology.optimized: Unchanged try_fused_vision_qk_rope; native fallback when it returns None. FP16 never activates the fused kernel.
methodology.timing: CUDA events with synchronization; no Python wallclock latency used
methodology.order: Alternating arms every round; second process reverses initial order, balancing 15 baseline-first and 15 optimized-first rounds overall.
methodology.eager_interpretation: GPU timeline includes CPU dispatch/allocation/enqueue gaps; graph timings better isolate repeated GPU operations.
methodology.graph_percentile_interpretation: p50/p90 across 30 per-operation batch averages, not individual-call tail latency.

limitations: Only B300/SM103; no other NVIDIA architectures tested.
Kernel/packing microbenchmark; no model weights, full vision tower, decoder, TTFT or serving throughput measured.
Default clocks/power configuration retained; shared host, other GPUs occupied during parts of the run.
FP16 is fallback coverage and has no fused-kernel performance claim.
Read-only inherited environment includes unrelated package metadata conflicts; imported kernel stack and extension ABI were verified explicitly.
Only preliminary handoff was available; fair benchmark implemented independently from the exact PR/base source.
